subject: reasoning
question: Ansh, Kautuk, Swati, Vansh, Navya, Deepak and Rani are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. Kautuk sits second to the right of Swati. Vansh sits to the immediate left of Ansh. Ansh sits second to the left of Swati. Navya sits third to the right of Rani. Who sits third to the left of Deepak?
solution:
**Given: **Ansh, Kautuk, Swati, Vansh, Navya, Deepak and Rani are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

Vansh sits to the immediate left of Ansh. Ansh sits second to the left of Swati. 

Kautuk sits second to the right of Swati. Navya sits third to the right of Rani. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26be66baff6d709a4dd57a75f4824458bb71fcd60307a4eafd0715b068025650.png] 

Thus, Ansh sits third to the left of Deepak.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
